{{Top|leg}}
A '''modular command circuit''' was a vital component of the [[Kalindan Defense System]]. Without the circuit, the network was unable to function. The [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Technician/Legends|technician]] in charge disabled the system and removed the command module. The technician was picked up by a [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[Frigate/Legends|frigate]] disguised as an Imperial frigate and he subsequently surrendered it into their custody believing he was reporting in to his superiors. Around [[6 ABY/Legends|6 ABY]], the New Republic arranged for the return of the command circuit in exchange for notes on [[Cloaking device/Legends|cloaking device]] countermeasures that the [[Kalindan Royal Research Facility]] was developing.
